## Falsification watch — what would change our minds

*The pre-registered trigger for every entry: meet one with evidence and the grade moves — in public, on the record. Live freshness is `make staleness`; re-grade cadence (CONTESTED 270 d · OPEN 180 d · ROBUST/REFUTED 540 d) is in [`docs/GRADING_PROTOCOL.md`](../docs/GRADING_PROTOCOL.md).*

- **[SAA-001](SAA-001-fascism-is-behavior.md)** · ROBUST · *Fascism is a form of political behavior, not a doctrine* — Downgrade if the field converges on an operational definition that supersedes Paxton's behavioral frame, or if his five-stage model is shown to misclassify canonical cases. Demote the *causal* rider (that open knowledge contains fascism by denying it cover) if forced-assent/signalling models are shown to dominate persuasion AND auditable-truth interventions show a null effect on backsliding rates.
- **[SAA-002](SAA-002-prebunking-works-at-scale.md)** · ROBUST · *Psychological inoculation ("prebunking") raises manipulation-resistance at scale* — Downgrade if large preregistered field trials fail to show improved manipulation-technique recognition, or if the existing effect does not survive replication.
- **[SAA-003](SAA-003-prebunking-transfer-contested.md)** · CONTESTED · *Prebunking does not reliably transfer to real true/false discrimination* — Move toward ROBUST-negative if further preregistered replications confirm null transfer; downgrade the concern if well-powered studies show durable real-world true/false discrimination gains.
- **[SAA-004](SAA-004-contact-reduces-prejudice.md)** · ROBUST · *Intergroup contact correlates with reduced prejudice* — Downgrade if bias-corrected meta-analyses null out even the descriptive correlation. (The strength/causality is already qualified by SAA-005.)
- **[SAA-005](SAA-005-contact-caveats.md)** · CONTESTED · *The contact evidence carries serious publication-bias and external-validity caveats* — Resolve toward ROBUST (effect real) or REFUTED (effect ~zero for policy) if well-powered, preregistered, adult, interracial field experiments settle the magnitude.
- **[SAA-006](SAA-006-status-threat-vs-economics.md)** · OPEN · *Status-threat vs economic-anxiety as the driver of authoritarian-populism is unresolved* — Resolve if cross-national panel data (not a single 2016 US case) adjudicates the relative weight of status threat vs economic interest.
- **[SAA-007](SAA-007-open-early-warning-exists.md)** · ROBUST · *Operational, openly-reproducible conflict early-warning systems exist* — Downgrade if the operational systems cease, or are shown to be non-reproducible or closed. (That a no-change/persistence baseline is a *hard benchmark* many models fail to beat under MSE on zero-inflated fatality levels is already true — verified and nuanced in [SAA-040](SAA-040-conflict-forecasting-track-record.md) — and is NOT a downgrade trigger here: this entry grades the existence of the open, reproducible, uncertainty-honest infrastructure, not forecast skill.)
- **[SAA-008](SAA-008-critical-mass-cascades-are-real.md)** · ROBUST · *Committed minorities can tip systems; change cascades through networks* — Downgrade if the convergent tipping/cascade mechanism fails to replicate, or if committed-minority effects are shown to be artifacts of specific experimental incentives.
- **[SAA-009](SAA-009-no-universal-threshold.md)** · ROBUST · *There is no universal critical-mass number, and cascades are not automatic* — Downgrade if a context-invariant universal tipping threshold is established across domains, or if cascades are shown to follow deterministically once a fixed fraction is reached.
- **[SAA-010](SAA-010-energy-is-complex-contagion.md)** · ROBUST · *The "energy" that drives cascades is complex contagion, not a mystical field* — Downgrade if simple-contagion (single-contact) models are shown to fully explain social-movement and norm spread without reinforcement effects. Demote the *network-structure* rider (clustering + wide bridges) separately — it is already contested: the reach-vs-reinforcement trade-off (arXiv:2411.07907, 2024) shows clustering helps only in a small region of parameter space and, in most cases, does not out-reach random networks.
- **[SAA-011](SAA-011-refuted-pseudoscience.md)** · REFUTED · *Refuted pseudoscience — "100th monkey", morphic resonance, consciousness fields* — Would require extraordinary, independently replicated, preregistered evidence with a physical mechanism to revisit. None exists.
- **[SAA-012](SAA-012-reverse-dominance-hierarchy.md)** · CONTESTED · *Reverse dominance hierarchy — the evolutionary root of resisting tyranny (contested)* — Move toward ROBUST if broad cross-cultural foraging data show near-universal *active* suppression of would-be dominators; toward REFUTED if the egalitarian-band pattern is shown to be a recent or marginal ('refugee population') artifact rather than an ancestral norm.
- **[SAA-013](SAA-013-ostrom-self-governance.md)** · ROBUST · *Self-governance can avoid both tyranny and collapse — Ostrom's design principles (robust locally)* — Downgrade if a large bias-corrected re-analysis finds the design principles do not predict commons sustainability; the global-scale limitation is already part of the claim, not a falsifier.
- **[SAA-014](SAA-014-peaceful-societies-war-antiquity.md)** · CONTESTED · *Peaceful societies exist and war is not inevitable — but war's antiquity is contested* — The *existence* claim is refuted if documented non-warring societies are shown to have endemic war; the *antiquity* question is resolved (either way) by decisive, representative archaeological evidence on pre-Neolithic lethal conflict.
- **[SAA-015](SAA-015-cultural-evolution-cooperation.md)** · ROBUST · *Cooperation and prosocial norms are culturally evolved (framework robust; the WEIRD mechanism contested)* — Framework downgrade if cultural transmission is shown NOT to drive cross-population variation in cooperation; the specific kinship-intensity → WEIRD-psychology mechanism is the contested part and may be revised without touching the framework.
- **[SAA-016](SAA-016-rwa-sdo-authoritarian-disposition.md)** · ROBUST · *RWA and SDO are robust, replicated individual-difference predictors of prejudice and anti-democratic attitudes* — A downgrade to CONTESTED would be warranted if large preregistered/multi-lab studies showed the RWA-prejudice and SDO-prejudice associations are substantially driven by item-content overlap (tautology) — i.e., that purging RWA/SDO items semantically overlapping the outcomes collapses the predictive relationships — or if the additive RWA+SDO model failed to replicate out-of-sample across cultures. A downgrade of the historical sub-claim would require evidence that the F-scale's acquiescence problem was not in fact a genuine validity threat or that the balanced RWA scale does not actually mitigate it.
- **[SAA-017](SAA-017-milgram-obedience.md)** · CONTESTED · *Milgram: the obedience EFFECT is robust/replicated; the 'blind obedience' INTERPRETATION is contested* — EFFECT layer would downgrade if a well-powered, pre-registered modern replication (or a meta-analysis of replications) found compliance collapsing to low rates under faithful procedures — i.e. the behavioral phenomenon proves era-/sample-bound. INTERPRETATION layer would move toward REFUTED-of-the-orthodox-reading (or conversely back toward 'blind obedience' being adequate) if pre-registered prod-manipulation and prototypicality studies converged decisively on one mechanism — e.g. consistent replication that order-like prods are as effective as scientific appeals would revive the obedience reading; consistent failure would finish off the orthodox interpretation. Discovery that Burger/Dolinski rates were inflated by selection or demand artifacts would weaken the effect layer.
- **[SAA-018](SAA-018-moral-foundations-theory.md)** · CONTESTED · *Moral Foundations Theory: 5/6 innate universal foundations explaining the left-right divide* — A downgrade toward REFUTED would follow if large pre-registered multi-country studies showed the MFQ-2's six-factor structure also fails configural/metric invariance across non-WEIRD samples. Conversely, an upgrade toward ROBUST would require independent (non-author) replications demonstrating that the MFQ-2 achieves at least metric invariance across a broad, representative set of WEIRD and non-WEIRD populations AND that the proposed foundations are recoverable as distinct factors in held-out samples not used in scale construction.
- **[SAA-019](SAA-019-minimal-group-paradigm.md)** · ROBUST · *Mere categorization into arbitrary groups produces in-group favoritism in resource allocation (minimal group paradigm)* — A high-powered, pre-registered multi-lab replication suite (e.g., a Registered Replication Report) that finds the minimal-group in-group allocation bias is null or negligible under the canonical Tajfel matrices once the moderators identified by Kerr et al. (2018) are held constant — i.e., showing the recovered effect is an artifact of those specific conditions rather than of categorization per se — would force a downgrade of the core effect from ROBUST to CONTESTED.
- **[SAA-020](SAA-020-asch-conformity.md)** · ROBUST · *Asch conformity: a unanimous wrong majority makes a substantial minority conform to obvious errors* — A well-powered, pre-registered multi-lab replication finding the standard unanimous-majority conformity rate is near zero or trivially small would refute the core (none exists; 2023 data go the other way). For the moderator layers: a controlled cross-national experiment showing the collectivist-individualist gap or the U.S. era decline disappears once task version, majority composition, and cohort confounds are held constant would downgrade those specific claims to REFUTED while leaving the core ROBUST.
- **[SAA-021](SAA-021-blatant-dehumanization.md)** · ROBUST · *Blatant dehumanization (Ascent of Man) predicts hostile/exclusionary policy support beyond prejudice* — A well-powered preregistered study (or meta-analysis) showing that, once a strong/extreme measure of antipathy or out-group dislike is controlled, the Ascent measure no longer adds incremental prediction of hostile/exclusionary outcomes — i.e., that its apparent unique variance is a measurement artifact of antipathy intensity rather than a distinct dehumanization construct — would downgrade the predictive layer to CONTESTED.
- **[SAA-022](SAA-022-dynamics-of-contention-mechanisms.md)** · CONTESTED · *Dynamics of Contention' mechanism-process program: influential framework, contested as underspecified* — Downgrade toward ROBUST if a substantial replication/meta-analytic literature shows the named mechanisms (brokerage, diffusion, scale shift, boundary activation) are independently operationalized with stated scope conditions and used to generate out-of-sample predictions that hold across many coded episodes. Conversely, push toward REFUTED if systematic review shows the program produced no cumulative, testable findings beyond relabeling and has been largely abandoned in the field. Current evidence — including the authors' own concessions and a still-active but self-critical research tradition — supports neither extreme, so CONTESTED stands.
- **[SAA-023](SAA-023-nonviolent-resistance-success.md)** · CONTESTED · *Nonviolent campaigns succeeded ~2x as often as violent ones (53% vs 26%) in 1900-2006 NAVCO data* — Downgrade to REFUTED if Crabtree & Holbein (or equivalent) survives peer review AND shows the descriptive 53/26 gap itself (not merely the causal estimate) is a coding artifact that vanishes under defensible recoding. Upgrade the causal layer toward ROBUST if pre-registered replications on expanded, audited data (correcting Anisin's omitted cases) recover a significant nonviolence advantage that is stable across specifications and fixed-effects designs.
- **[SAA-024](SAA-024-social-capital.md)** · CONTESTED · *Social capital robustly correlates with governance, but causal direction and decline are contested* — The grade moves toward ROBUST if well-identified causal designs confirm the bottom-up Putnam arrow net of institutional-quality confounders AND longitudinal data show a uniform secular decline. It moves toward REFUTED if the core cross-sectional association fails to replicate once income, education, ethnic homogeneity, and institutional quality are controlled.
- **[SAA-025](SAA-025-repression-backfire.md)** · ROBUST · *Repression backfire is real but conditional, not universal; net effect on mobilization is unresolved* — The ROBUST grade on the mechanism layer would fall to CONTESTED if a well-identified body of evidence (e.g., experiments or natural experiments) showed that even under the specified conditions — illegitimacy, high visibility, low fear, strong collective identity — repression reliably fails to increase mobilization. Conversely, the REFUTED grade on the universal-effect layer would have to be revised if a credible meta-analysis established a consistent positive average effect of repression on mobilization across contexts (no such consensus exists today).
- **[SAA-026](SAA-026-affective-polarization.md)** · CONTESTED · *US affective polarization is real, rising, and well-measured; its causal harm to democracy is contested* — The causal layer would upgrade toward ROBUST if a well-powered, pre-registered replication or meta-analysis showed that experimentally lowering affective polarization reliably increases support for democracy / reduces endorsement of norm violations in the same direction across samples. Conversely, the descriptive core would be REFUTED only if the ANES out-party-animus rise were shown to be largely a measurement/mode artifact — which current robustness tests have so far rejected.
- **[SAA-027](SAA-027-depolarization-megastudy.md)** · ROBUST · *Megastudies cut partisan animosity, but that does not reliably lower anti-democratic attitudes* — A well-powered replication or re-analysis showing that, across a diverse treatment set, effects on partisan animosity are in fact strongly correlated (r >= ~0.4) with effects on support for undemocratic practices and partisan violence — i.e., that animosity reduction does causally and reliably transmit to anti-democratic attitudes — would refute layer (b). For layer (a), failure to reproduce broad, immediately-detectable animosity reductions in a comparable large sample would downgrade it.
- **[SAA-028](SAA-028-democratic-recession-2024.md)** · ROBUST · *V-Dem and Freedom House measure a multi-decade global democratic recession; its global magnitude is contested* — A credible replication showing that the V-Dem/Freedom House decline is driven by time-varying expert pessimism or threshold/classification artifacts (e.g., demonstrating that the 72% figure flips with defensible alternative coding of a few large states), AND a peer-reviewed result that objective non-electoral institutional indicators (judicial independence, press freedom measured by events, not ratings) are also flat — would downgrade Layer 1 toward CONTESTED. Conversely, a future report year showing sustained reversal of the decline would refute the 'ongoing wave' framing.
- **[SAA-029](SAA-029-anocracy-factionalism.md)** · CONTESTED · *Anocracy + factionalism robustly forecasts instability, but the causal 'anocracy causes civil war' reading is partly a Polity coding artifact* — A downgrade to REFUTED for the causal layer would be triggered by broad replication showing the anocracy/factionalism→civil-war relationship holds with endogeneity-purged measures (X-Polity, V-Dem horizontal/vertical constraints) across datasets. Conversely, the forecasting layer would be downgraded if the PITF model's out-of-sample accuracy failed to replicate on post-2003 data. An upgrade of the overall entry toward ROBUST would require defenders to show the ~30x factionalism odds survive removal of the PARCOMP/PARREG components.
- **[SAA-030](SAA-030-political-violence-overestimated.md)** · ROBUST · *Face-value survey estimates of US support for partisan violence are inflated by measurement error* — A well-powered study using best-practice attention screening, bogus-respondent removal, and act-specific severity-disambiguated items that nonetheless finds double-digit sincere support for serious partisan violence (assault/murder) among ordinary partisans — or a demonstration that the corrections themselves (e.g. attention checks, severity framing) systematically suppress genuine sincere endorsement, restoring high estimates — would downgrade the core to CONTESTED.
- **[SAA-031](SAA-031-financial-crises-far-right.md)** · ROBUST · *Severe financial crises are systematically followed by far-right gains and political fragmentation* — A well-identified replication/extension that (a) shows the far-right rise after financial crises is statistically indistinguishable from the rise after equally severe non-financial recessions once confounders are controlled, or (b) demonstrates the post-2008/post-COVID cohort breaks the historical regularity (no systematic far-right gain), would downgrade the descriptive core to CONTESTED. Confirmation that the effect is fully mediated by pre-existing cultural cleavages rather than the crisis itself would refute the financial-crisis scope condition.
- **[SAA-032](SAA-032-income-democracy.md)** · CONTESTED · *Income-democracy correlation is robust (Lipset); the causal claim income→democratization is contested* — CORRELATION layer downgrades from ROBUST only if a current-data replication overturns the long-standing positive cross-national income-democracy association. CAUSAL layer moves OFF 'contested': to ROBUST(positive) if a consensus of fixed-effects/IV panel studies using censoring-aware, nonlinear estimators converges on a clearly positive within-country effect; to REFUTED if the literature converges on a robust null/zero within-country effect across estimators, samples, and horizons. Either convergence would collapse the current live disagreement.
- **[SAA-033](SAA-033-inequality-democratic-erosion.md)** · CONTESTED · *Inequality robustly correlates with democratic erosion risk, but causal direction and scope are contested* — The associational/ROBUST core would downgrade if a well-powered replication or extension of Rau & Stokes with stronger identification (e.g., instrumented or within-country shock designs) failed to recover the inequality→erosion association, or if the result proved sensitive to the V-Dem erosion coding or to a handful of influential cases. The overall CONTESTED grade would UPGRADE toward ROBUST if multiple credibly-causal designs (natural experiments, IV) converged on inequality raising erosion risk with the reverse arrow held fixed; it would move toward REFUTED if the cross-national correlation itself dissolved under standard controls.
- **[SAA-034](SAA-034-resource-curse.md)** · CONTESTED · *Oil/mineral wealth correlates robustly with authoritarianism; the unconditional causal 'curse' is contested* — The robust-association layer would fall if a well-identified design (e.g., exogenous price/discovery shocks or large-N natural experiments) showed the oil-democracy correlation is an artifact of selection with no underlying relationship. The contested-causation layer would resolve toward REFUTED if subsequent replications consistently confirmed Haber-Menaldo's no-effect/blessing result under credible identification and overturned Andersen-Ross's post-1980 finding; it would move toward ROBUST if causal designs broadly converged on a durable anti-democratic effect.
- **[SAA-035](SAA-035-trade-shock-polarization.md)** · CONTESTED · *Import (China-shock) exposure raised far-right/populist voting in exposed regions — robust core, contested magnitude* — A downgrade to REFUTED would be triggered by: (a) credible re-analyses showing the ADHM/Colantone-Stanig results are artifacts of the shift-share instrument's invalidity (e.g. share-exogeneity violations) and vanish under the Borusyak/Adão corrected inference, OR (b) replication/meta-analytic work showing the bias-corrected pooled effect is statistically indistinguishable from zero. An upgrade toward ROBUST would require the causal-magnitude headline to survive correction with a substantively meaningful, geographically broader effect.
- **[SAA-036](SAA-036-algorithmic-radicalization.md)** · CONTESTED · *Algorithmic "rabbit-hole" radicalization on YouTube is contested; extremist consumption is largely demand-driven* — Move toward REFUTED-of-the-strong-claim if well-powered counterfactual studies converge that the live recommender does not measurably increase extremist uptake for ordinary users; move toward an algorithmic-amplification finding (a separate, stronger claim) if counterfactual experiments show YouTube's recommender materially drives ordinary users into extremist consumption, not just resentful ones who self-select.
- **[SAA-037](SAA-037-executive-aggrandizement.md)** · ROBUST · *Modern democratic backsliding is mostly gradual executive aggrandizement by elected incumbents, not coups* — Downgrade if systematic re-coding shows the modern erosion cases are predominantly abrupt seizures (military/executive coups or open election-day fraud) rather than gradual incumbent-led aggrandizement, or if the typology is shown to misclassify the bulk of post–Cold War cases.
- **[SAA-038](SAA-038-lateral-reading.md)** · ROBUST · *Lateral reading is the expert strategy for evaluating online sources, and teaching it improves credibility judgments* — Downgrade if larger, pre-registered replications fail to find the lateral-reading accuracy advantage, or if taught lateral reading does not improve credibility judgments. The *durable real-world transfer* sub-claim is held weaker by design (see [[SAA-003]]); evidence that taught lateral reading does not persist or transfer would narrow, not overturn, the entry.
- **[SAA-039](SAA-039-institutions-prosperity.md)** · CONTESTED · *Institutions-prosperity correlation is robust (AJR); the causal claim inclusive institutions→long-run prosperity is contested* — CORRELATION layer downgrades from ROBUST only if a current-data replication overturns the strong cross-national association between institutional-quality measures and long-run income. CAUSAL layer moves OFF 'contested': to ROBUST if independent re-analyses of the settler-mortality IV — using corrected/disaggregated mortality data (answering Albouy) and modern inference — plus at least one independent identification strategy converge on a large positive institutions→income effect that survives separating institutions from human capital (answering Glaeser et al.); to REFUTED-of-the-strong-form if the literature converges on both (a) the AJR IV estimates not surviving data corrections and (b) alternative designs attributing the bulk of long-run development to human capital or persistent population characteristics rather than place-based institutions (the Glaeser / Chanda-Cook-Putterman line). Either convergence collapses the live disagreement.
- **[SAA-040](SAA-040-conflict-forecasting-track-record.md)** · CONTESTED · *Conflict/backsliding forecasting has a real, peer-reviewed out-of-sample track record — but 'beats a no-change baseline' is metric- and task-dependent, not a settled fact* — Two-layer downgrade rule. ROBUST layer (the infrastructure + the published out-of-sample track record) downgrades only if ViEWS/VIEWS ceases operation or its replication code is shown non-reproducible, or if the Hegre et al. (2021) retrospective finding ('reasonably accurate' predictions, ISQ) is overturned by a re-evaluation against a longer realized series. The CONTESTED headline layer ('beats baseline' is metric-dependent) moves to ROBUST only if a future VIEWS Challenge converges on a single skill metric under which the best models *robustly* beat no-change across both fatality levels AND escalation/changes; it moves toward REFUTED-of-skill if convergence instead shows ensemble models *cannot* beat the persistence baseline under any standard metric over a multi-year realized horizon.
- **[SAA-041](SAA-041-three-five-percent-rule.md)** · CONTESTED · *The 3.5% rule is a strong descriptive tendency, not a law — its own author documents the exceptions and warns against prescriptive use* — Two-layer rule. The CONTESTED grade splits REFUTED-as-iron-law (already falsified by its own author: Brunei 1962 and Bahrain 2011-2014 both exceeded 3.5% peak participation and decisively failed) from ROBUST-as-tendency (in NAVCO 1.2, campaigns at >=3.5% peak participation succeeded 88.89% of the time — 16 of 18 — vs 60.98% in the 1-3.5% band; table significance p<.003). Downgrade the tendency layer toward REFUTED if a future NAVCO release or an independent recoding audit shows the >=3.5% success rate falling to statistical indistinguishability from the 1-3.5% band, or shows the peak-participation estimates behind the 18 cases to be coding artifacts concealing further exceptions. Upgrade toward ROBUST (explicitly as a tendency, never as a law) if post-2014 data adds a meaningful number of new >=3.5% campaigns whose success rate stays significantly above the sub-threshold bands with no new exception class beyond the small-monarchy-with-foreign-reinforcement profile.
